summary: Wise Group plc filed a Form 6-K on August 18, 2026, reporting transactions in its own shares under an ongoing buyback program announced July 21, 2026. Between August 10–14, 2026, it repurchased 525,000 Class A shares on Nasdaq and 559,514 shares on London venues at volume-weighted average prices of USD 12.5650 and GBP 9.2553, respectively, through Goldman Sachs International. The repurchased shares will be held in treasury. The program expects to repurchase up to £405 million (~$540 million). This is a routine issuer repurchase, not a tender offer.
